sources.title: Mistral Saba
sources.evidence: Dated February 17, 2025. Announces a 24B-parameter regional language model trained on Middle Eastern and South Asian data, supporting Arabic and Indian languages including Tamil. Access is through API or customer-premises deployment arranged with Mistral.

sources.title: Mistral Saba v25.02 model documentation
sources.evidence: Identifies a fine-tuned Small model, Premier classification, mistral-saba-2502/latest aliases, 32k context, and retirement on September 30, 2025. Page HTML modality tooltips explicitly specify Text input and Text output.

sources.title: Mistral Saba 24B - GroqDocs
sources.evidence: Official deployment documentation explicitly describes Saba as a 24B dense Transformer and states a 32K-token capacity. This is direct architecture evidence, not inference from Mistral Small or the parameter count.

sources.title: Mistral Saba model lifecycle
sources.evidence: Lifecycle table confirms release February 17, 2025 and retirement September 30, 2025.

sources.title: Pinned official Mistral Saba 25.02 model definition
sources.evidence: Exact Saba definition lists version25.02, Premier type, weights:[], paperlink:null, contextLength:32k, text input/output, exactAPIaliases, February17 release and September30 retirement. It provides no active parameter count; empty feature list does not establish historical lack of tools. No Small sibling counts are transferred.

sources.title: OpenRouter Saba 2502 endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct HTTP JSON access succeeded. Mistral provider routes list 32,768 context tokens, 26,214 maximum completion tokens, tools/tool_choice parameters and explicit none/auto/required/function tool-choice support. File input is gateway metadata. Endpoint listing is not an inference request or proof of current operation.

sources.title: Magistral announcement
sources.evidence: On June 10, 2025 Mistral introduced Magistral as its first reasoning model. This was checked as historical context, but it does not explicitly classify the exact Saba 25.02 release and is insufficient to verify a false reasoning flag.

sources.title: PDF Inputs
sources.evidence: PDFs work with any OpenRouter model. For models without native file input, OpenRouter parses files and forwards the results; text-only models receive parsed text. Gateway file/PDF support does not establish native Saba multimodality.

sources.title: Mistral Docs model-type definitions
sources.evidence: The Premier badge translation context explicitly calls it a commercial AI model; Open is separately defined as publicly available open weights. Used together with Saba's empty weights list and enterprise distribution description for a descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: mistral-common source and documentation inventory
sources.evidence: Inspected the current main tree and fetched 65 Python/Markdown files under docs/ and src/ through raw.githubusercontent.com. No Saba mention was found in that bounded source/documentation set, so it provided no exact-model non-reasoning declaration.

name.note: Use the full developer-published model name; Saba is the shorter catalog label.

developer.note: Mistral AI is the developer; retain the catalog developer label.

family.note: Retain the broad Mistral family grouping. The exact regional release is Saba 25.02, described as a fine-tuned Small model.

release_date.note: Explicit original developer release date, not the later Groq rollout.

open_weights.note: Commercial/Premier distribution and no public weight artifacts. Customer-premises availability is not public open-weight distribution.

license.note: Descriptive commercial classification. No public named weight license is supplied; do not transfer Apache-2.0 from Mistral Small.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total in billions. No exact tensor count is disclosed for Saba; no public checkpoint was found for independent counting.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active count found in the announcement, deployment docs, or later first-party model comparison metadata. Dense architecture alone does not justify copying the nominal total.

architecture.note: Groq explicitly identifies the exact Saba model as a dense Transformer. No layer/configuration or sibling-architecture inference is used.

context_window.note: Mistral publishes rounded 32k; Groq says 32K. Retain the exact 32,768 documented for Mistral routes by OpenRouter, as an API limit, not a proved native positional ceiling. Its 26,214 output cap is separate.

modalities.note: Native text input/output are explicit in the developer metadata and page tooltips. Remove PDF from the model modality field; gateway PDF parsing is separate.

reasoning.note: No explicit exact-model reasoning or non-reasoning declaration was found. The retired Saba card has no reasoning classification; omission of reasoning controls from route metadata and the later Magistral first-reasoning-model announcement do not verify a Saba-specific false. Clear the baseline flag pending direct evidence.

tool_call.note: Explicit tool-choice modes and tools parameter support are documented for the Saba 2502 Mistral routes. The retired developer page omits feature badges, which is not a negative historical claim.

patch.description: Mistral's 24B text model fine-tuned for Arabic and South Asian languages, including Tamil.

sources.label: Pinned official Mistral Saba 25.02 model definition

patch.notes: 24B is the developer-reported nominal total; no exact or separately defined active count is disclosed. Groq explicitly documents a dense Transformer. Mistral gives 32k context; 32,768 is the documented OpenRouter Mistral-route limit, with a separate 26,214 output cap, not an independently verified native positional ceiling. Native input/output are text; PDF handling is gateway preprocessing. Mistral marks Saba 25.02 retired on 2025-09-30; surviving provider metadata does not prove current endpoint operation. Saba-specific reasoning-mode status is unverified; the earlier false flag is cleared rather than inferred from the later Magistral announcement.

summary: Confirmed the original Saba 25.02 identity and release date; added nominal 24B parameters, directly documented dense architecture, and proprietary classification. Corrected native modalities to text-only and replaced generic descriptive claims. Retained documented API context and tool support with provider scope explicit. Active count and exact total remain undisclosed. Mistral now marks the release retired. Exact-model reasoning-mode status remains unverified, and the baseline false is explicitly cleared.

research_notes.search_scope: Checked the original announcement, current developer card and legal lifecycle, later first-party comparison/model metadata, official Groq deployment documentation, and the exact OpenRouter 2502 endpoint metadata. Targeted exact-model searches for later technical reports, active parameters, architecture, training and interpretability disclosures did not reveal a separate exact or active count. No sibling count was transferred.
research_notes.access_limitations: Web open of the OpenRouter JSON endpoint failed, but direct HTTPS access returned complete JSON. No paid inference request was made; route metadata and retirement status are recorded separately.
research_notes.variant: mistral-saba-2502 / mistral-saba-latest; not a later Small model or the distinct base/pretrain benchmark series.
research_notes.reasoning_followup: Searched Mistral Docs, official mistral-common documentation and mistralai GitHub for exact Saba/reasoning terms, then checked the 65 Python/Markdown files under docs/ and src/ in mistral-common main. No Saba-specific declaration was found. The later Magistral announcement and absent API reasoning controls are retained as search coverage, not proof of false.
